title: Claim
description: One verifiable claim extracted from a repo's own documentation. A claim is never a verdict; the verdict lives on the verification that references it.

id.description: Stable claim id, c1..c999. Assigned by the analyzer.

quote.description: Exact text as it appears in the source. Must be a substring of the cited file.

regression_test.description: Path to a test that would fail if the claim stopped being true. Null when none exists.
